notice: Factory-authored engineering requirements. These are declarations, not observations of a third-party game, market evidence, or human playtest results.

coreLoop: Start in a ready state on a fixed course
Tap to flip and move forward
Cut a soft target and let its pieces drop
Avoid the visible hard hazard or fail with an attributable cause
Reach the finish, settle, and replay
progressionSystems: Advance through an authored target, hazard and finish sequence
unlockRules: Replay becomes available after failure or finish
mustPreserveMechanics: Soft cut and hard obstacle contact are different branches
Visible contact failure and one-action retry
adaptableMechanics: Original name, geometry, course content, colors, UI, audio and tuning

checks.expectedStateChange: Blade leaves ready and changes trajectory
checks.spatialRelationship: Blade moves along the visible course

checks.playerInput: Tap to intersect the soft target
checks.expectedStateChange: Target separates and falls away from its source
checks.spatialRelationship: Contact must occur at the target rather than a sibling object

checks.playerInput: Allow hazard contact, then tap retry
checks.expectedStateChange: Attributable failure is followed by a clean ready state
checks.spatialRelationship: Hazard is visible on the upcoming course before contact

checks.expectedStateChange: Contact precedes cut and falling pieces
checks.spatialRelationship: Feedback remains local to the cut object

checks.playerInput: Tap through the course, then tap replay
checks.expectedStateChange: Finish enters settlement and replay resets
checks.spatialRelationship: Finish remains distinct from hazards and targets

pressure.trigger: Blade contacts a visible hard hazard
pressure.playerSignal: Distinct visible hazard silhouette before impact
pressure.escalation: Forward motion reduces the safe timing window
pressure.failureOutcome: Attempt stops with a visible contact cause
pressure.attribution: Failure feedback identifies the contacted hazard
pressure.recovery: A visible retry control resets the initial course
